about: Heather A. Salg is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2027. She works at Colorado Industry Care Standards, LLC, located in Glenwood Springs, Colorado, and provides legal services for issues involving Civil Litigation: Defense, Appellate and Insurance Coverage to the surrounding community.
Heather Salg completed legal studies at University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated with the class of 1998. Heather Salg passed the bar in 1998.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
